review.scope: All seven canonical UI additions for feature 317, derived from canonical_sources()['ui'] minus en.UI_SOURCES. Actual form applications are distinct from accepted CSV keys; other-form settings are distinct from unknown or retired settings.
review.limitations: AI semantic review against canonical English source; not native-speaker human review or approval. Identifiers, placeholders and the protected UI names Live Preview and Run are preserved.
